readings.title: A Song of Deliverance
readings.subtitle: Dawiḏ Praises YeHoVaH for Rescue
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:1] And Dawiḏ spoke to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> the words of this song, on the day when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Sha’ul. [2] And he said, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer. [3] “My <dn>Elohim</dn> is my rock, I take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>, my shield and the horn of my deliverance, my high tower and my refuge. My <dn>Saviour</dn>, <dn>You</dn> save me from violence. [4] “I call on <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the <dn>One</dn> to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies. [5] “For the waves of death surrounded me, floods of Beliyya‛al made me afraid. [6] “The cords of the grave surrounded me, the snares of death confronted me. [7] “In my distress I called upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and to my <dn>Elohim</dn> I cried. And <dn>He</dn> heard my voice from <dn>His</dn> Hěḵal, and my cry was in <dn>His</dn> ears. [8] “And the earth shook and trembled, the foundations of the heavens were troubled, and shook because <dn>He</dn> was wroth. [9] “Smoke went up from <dn>His</dn> nostrils, and devouring fire from <dn>His</dn> mouth; coals were kindled by it. [10] “And <dn>He</dn> bowed the heavens and came down, and thick darkness was under <dn>His</dn> feet. [11] “And <dn>He</dn> rode upon a keruḇ, and flew; and <dn>He</dn> was seen upon the wings of the wind. [12] “And <dn>He</dn> made darkness canopies around <dn>Him</dn>, gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies. [13] “From the brightness before <dn>Him</dn>, coals of fire were kindled. [14] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> thundered from the heavens, and the <dn>Most High</dn> sent forth <dn>His</dn> voice. [15] “And <dn>He</dn> sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning, and confused them. [16] “And the channels of the sea were seen, the foundations of the world were uncovered, at the rebuke of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, at the blast of the breath of <dn>His</dn> nostrils. [17] “<dn>He</dn> sent from above, <dn>He</dn> took me, <dn>He</dn> drew me out of many waters. [18] “<dn>He</dn> delivered me from my strong enemy, from those hating me, for they were stronger than I. [19] “They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was my support. [20] “And <dn>He</dn> brought me out into a large place; <dn>He</dn> delivered me, because <dn>He</dn> delighted in me.”

readings.title: Rewarded According to Righteousness
readings.subtitle: The Cleanness of His Hands
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:21] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands <dn>He</dn> repaid me. [22] “For I have guarded the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and have not acted wickedly against my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [23] “For all <dn>His</dn> right-rulings are before me; as for <dn>His</dn> laws, I do not turn from them. [24] “And I am perfect before <dn>Him</dn>, and I guard myself from my crookedness. [25] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> repays me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness before <dn>His</dn> eyes. [26] “With the kind <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> kind, with the perfect one <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> perfect, [27] “With the pure <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> pure, and with the crooked <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> twisted. [28] “And <dn>You</dn> save <dn>את</dn> the afflicted people, but <dn>Your</dn> eyes are upon the haughty, to bring them low. [29] “For <dn>You</dn> are my lamp, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> makes my darkness light. [30] “For with <dn>You</dn> I run against a band, with my <dn>Elohim</dn> I leap over a wall.”

readings.title: Girded with Strength
readings.subtitle: The Anointed King Triumphs
readings.text: [2 Samuel 22:31] “The <dn>El</dn> – <dn>His</dn> way is perfect; the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is proven; <dn>He</dn> is a shield to all who take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [32] “For who is <dn>El</dn>, besides <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? And who is a rock, besides our <dn>Elohim</dn>? [33] “<dn>El</dn> is my strong fortress, and <dn>He</dn> makes my way perfect. [34] “Making my feet like the feet of deer, and sets me on my high places. [35] “Teaching my hands for battle, so that my arms shall bend a bow of bronze. [36] “And <dn>You</dn> give me the shield of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, and <dn>Your</dn> lowliness makes me great. [37] “<dn>You</dn> enlarge my step under me, so that my feet shall not slip. [38] “I pursue my enemies and destroy them, and do not turn back until they are destroyed. [39] “And I destroy them and crush them, so that they do not rise, and fall under my feet. [40] “And <dn>You</dn> gird me with strength for battle, <dn>You</dn> cause my adversaries to bow under me. [41] “And <dn>You</dn> have made my enemies turn their backs, as for those hating me, I destroyed them. [42] “They looked, but there was no saviour; unto <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but <dn>He</dn> did not answer them. [43] “And I beat them as dust of the earth, I beat them small as dirt of the streets, I spread them out. [44] “And <dn>You</dn> deliver me from the strivings of my people, <dn>You</dn> keep me as the head of the nations; a people I have not known serve me. [45] “Sons of the foreigner submit to me; as soon as they hear, they obey me. [46] “Sons of the foreigner fade away, and come frightened from their hiding places. [47] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives! And blessed is my <dn>Rock</dn>! And exalted is my <dn>Elohim</dn>, the <dn>Rock</dn> of my deliverance, [48] “The <dn>El</dn> who avenges me, and bringing peoples down under me, [49] “And bringing me out from my enemies. <dn>You</dn> raise me up above those rising up against me; <dn>You</dn> deliver me from a man of violence. [50] “Therefore I give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among nations, and I sing praise to <dn>Your</dn> Name. [51] “A tower of deliverance is <dn>He</dn> to <dn>His</dn> king, and showing loving-commitment to <dn>His</dn> anointed, to Dawiḏ and his seed, forever.”

readings.title: A Song of Deliverance (Psalm)
readings.subtitle: Dawiḏ's Cry to the Rock
readings.text: [Psalm 18:1] To the chief singer. A Psalm of Dawiḏ the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who spoke to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> the words of this song on the day that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Sha’ul. And he said: “I love <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my strength. [2] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer; my <dn>El</dn> is my rock, I take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>; my shield and the horn of my deliverance, my high tower. [3] “I call upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the <dn>One</dn> to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies. [4] “The cords of death were around me, and the floods of Beliyya‛al made me afraid. [5] “The cords of the grave were all around me; the snares of death confronted me. [6] “In my distress I called upon <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and cried out to my <dn>Elohim</dn>; <dn>He</dn> heard my voice from <dn>His</dn> Hěḵal, and my cry came before <dn>Him</dn>, into <dn>His</dn> ears. [7] “Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, because <dn>He</dn> was wroth. [8] “Smoke went up from <dn>His</dn> nostrils, and devouring fire from <dn>His</dn> mouth; coals were kindled by it. [9] “And <dn>He</dn> bowed the heavens and came down, and thick darkness was under <dn>His</dn> feet. [10] “And <dn>He</dn> rode upon a keruḇ, and flew; <dn>He</dn> flew upon the wings of the wind. [11] “<dn>He</dn> made darkness <dn>His</dn> hiding place, <dn>His</dn> canopy around <dn>Him</dn>, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies. [12] “From the brightness before <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>His</dn> thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire. [13] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> thundered in the heavens, and the <dn>Most High</dn> sent forth <dn>His</dn> voice, hail and coals of fire. [14] “And <dn>He</dn> sent out <dn>His</dn> arrows and scattered them, and much lightning, and confused them. [15] “Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at <dn>Your</dn> rebuke, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, at the blast of the breath of <dn>Your</dn> nostrils. [16] “<dn>He</dn> sent from above, <dn>He</dn> took me; <dn>He</dn> drew me out of many waters. [17] “<dn>He</dn> delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those hating me, for they were stronger than I. [18] “They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was my support. [19] “And <dn>He</dn> brought me out into a large place; <dn>He</dn> delivered me, because <dn>He</dn> delighted in me.”

readings.title: Repaid for Righteousness
readings.subtitle: The Purity of His Ways
readings.text: [Psalm 18:20] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands <dn>He</dn> repaid me. [21] “For I have guarded the ways of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and have not acted wickedly against my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [22] “For all <dn>His</dn> right-rulings are before me, and I did not turn from <dn>His</dn> laws. [23] “And I am perfect before <dn>Him</dn>, and I guard myself from my crookedness. [24] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> repays me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before <dn>His</dn> eyes. [25] “With the kind <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> kind; with the perfect one <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> perfect; [26] “With the pure <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> pure; and with the crooked <dn>You</dn> show <dn>Yourself</dn> twisted. [27] “For <dn>You</dn> save the afflicted people, but bring down haughty eyes. [28] “For <dn>You</dn> light my lamp; <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> makes my darkness light. [29] “For with <dn>You</dn> I run against a band, and with my <dn>Elohim</dn> I leap over a wall.”

readings.title: Victory Over the Nations
readings.subtitle: The Head of the Heathen
readings.text: [Psalm 18:30] “The <dn>El</dn> – <dn>His</dn> way is perfect; the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is proven; <dn>He</dn> is a shield to all who take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>. [31] “For who is <dn>Elohim</dn>, besides <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? And who is a rock, besides our <dn>Elohim</dn>? [32] “The <dn>El</dn> who girds me with strength, and makes my way perfect, [33] “Making my feet like the feet of deer, and sets me on my high places, [34] “Teaching my hands for battle, so that my arms shall bend a bow of bronze. [35] “And <dn>You</dn> give me the shield of <dn>Your</dn> deliverance; and <dn>Your</dn> right hand supports me, and <dn>Your</dn> lowliness makes me great. [36] “<dn>You</dn> enlarge my step under me, so that my feet shall not slip. [37] “I pursue my enemies and overtake them, and do not turn back until they are destroyed. [38] “I crush them, and they are unable to rise; they fall under my feet. [39] “And <dn>You</dn> gird me with strength for battle; <dn>You</dn> cause my adversaries to bow under me. [40] “And <dn>You</dn> have made my enemies turn their backs, as for those hating me, I destroyed them. [41] “They cry out, but there is no saviour; unto <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but <dn>He</dn> did not answer them. [42] “And I beat them as dust before the wind; I empty them out like dirt in the streets. [43] “<dn>You</dn> deliver me from the strivings of the people; <dn>You</dn> make me the head of the nations; a people I have not known serve me. [44] “As soon as they hear they obey me; sons of the foreigner submit to me. [45] “Sons of the foreigner fade away, and come frightened from their hiding places. [46] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lives! And blessed is my <dn>Rock</dn>! And exalted is the <dn>Elohim</dn> of my deliverance, [47] “The <dn>El</dn> who avenges me, and subdues peoples under me; [48] “My deliverer from my enemies. <dn>You</dn> raise me up above those rising up against me; <dn>You</dn> deliver me from a man of violence. [49] “Therefore I give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among nations, and I sing praise to <dn>Your</dn> Name. [50] “<dn>He</dn> is making great the deliverance of <dn>His</dn> king, and showing loving-commitment to <dn>His</dn> anointed, to Dawiḏ and his seed, forever.”
